tools.name: get_ringscout_pricing_and_status
tools.description: Read-only free tool returning RingScout's coverage (India), supported local business categories (restaurants, hotels, salons, spas, clinics, diagnostic centres, petrol pumps, pharmacies, auto shops), active free/paid call status, and live telephony readiness.

tools.name: scout_places_on_google_maps
tools.description: Finds local businesses on Google Maps in India and calls up to five in parallel in Indian English, Hindi, or Hinglish to verify what's happening right now: restaurant tables & wait times, hotel rooms, early check-in & direct tariffs, same-day salon/spa appointments, clinic/diagnostic slots & charges

tools.name: scout_india_local_businesses
tools.description: Alias for `scout_places_on_google_maps`: contacts up to five local businesses on Google Maps in India in parallel to verify live availability, wait times, and ₹ prices, with recorded call audio when available. Provides information only; does not make reservations, purchases, or appointments.
